reviewer: solar26_observations; non-author of PlanetSelector and Beyond workspace layout

findings.cause: The fixed-position satellite flyout allowed a 460px height irrespective of its anchor top. Adding the Beyond navigation entry lowered Saturn; the final Explore Saturn System button remained below the viewport even after internal scrolling.
findings.evidence: The original actual Windows Edge/NVIDIA journey D timed out on a normal Playwright click with element is outside of the viewport. D-failure.png shows the flyout beginning near y=576 and continuing below the 900px viewport.
findings.correction: Bound inline maxHeight to max(0,min(460,innerHeight-position.top-12)). Existing border-box sizing includes padding; existing overflow:auto allows all rows and the final action to scroll into the visible region. Existing resize/scroll listeners update placement. Selection handlers and navigation state are unchanged.
findings.qualification: Independently source reviewed. The next actual journey used a normal click, entered the ready Saturn system, captured D-return-saturn-system.png, then reached native Sky and Earth. This corrects the specific flyout defect.
findings.status: Corrected; scoped source and actual navigation evidence reviewed

layout_observations: At 844×390, the earlier landscape tabs began at 154px and observation pane at 202px, leaving about 80px before the footer. The new scoped media override moves tabs to 112px, context/observation to 160px and reduces the title block. Actual new D and C landscape captures confirm the added central space.

The landscape title and evidence badge remain visible; the explanatory introductory paragraph is hidden only for short wide viewports. Source/context content remains in its scrollable panel and the Science & sources action remains visible.

At 390×844 the portrait Oort capture separates the scene, scrollable theoretical-extents panel and footer. Return, recenter and sources controls remain visible. The IMAP portrait workspace retains a scrollable content pane and the shared footer. These are viewport captures, not physical phone evidence.
Actual journeys-final layout records report all essential header/action controls within the viewport and hit-testable for the inspected C/D captures.

validation.command_results: Source diff is the one maxHeight addition; whitespace and harness syntax checks pass.
validation.actual_run: Parent-owned Windows Edge/NVIDIA journeys-final, 2026-11-08T06:09:37.814Z to 06:10:50.099Z; A/B/C PASS. D passed the corrected Saturn action and native mode transitions but its final assertion rejected latitude 35.24720000000313 versus 35.2472 by string equality. The entire D journey is not marked passed on this evidence.

Finite latitude/longitude remain within1e-9degrees and elevation within1e-4metres; exact UTC preserved. Actual maximum deltas are retained in qualified_runtime_evidence.

All 8 cases passed.
